items.description: Analyze repository modules and end-to-end dataflow before any research execution
items.acceptance_criteria: Write `results/phase_1/repo_module_map.md` documenting purpose and interfaces of `.archivara/concept_evolve.py`, `.archivara/semantic_scholar.py`, `.opencode/tools/concept_evolve.ts`, `.opencode/tools/semantic_scholar.ts`, `.opencode/agents/*.md`, and exactly how artifacts flow into `results/concept_evolve/`.

items.description: Formalize the target theorem statement and measurable success milestones for tighter Bu bounds
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/phase_1/problem_spec.md` with formal definitions of `B_f`, `B_u`, baseline lower bound `0.5708858`, at least 3 numeric improvement milestones above baseline, and a checklist of rigor requirements for claiming any new lower bound.

items.description: Run web-based state-of-the-art review spanning papers and implementation repositories
items.acceptance_criteria: Use web search to collect and save `results/phase_1/literature_scan.json` with at least 20 unique sources, including at least 10 peer-reviewed papers and 3 code repositories relevant to Bloch/Landau constants, schlicht extremals, Loewner methods, and rigorous numerics.

items.description: Create and maintain canonical bibliography for all consulted prior work
items.acceptance_criteria: Create/update `sources.bib` in repo root with valid BibTeX entries for all consulted sources, explicitly including Skinner (2009), Yanagihara (1995), and Bhowmik-Sen (2023), with at least 10 relevant papers cited total.

items.description: Delegate literature exploration and synthesis through subagents
items.acceptance_criteria: Perform at least one exploration delegation and one synthesis delegation; save `results/phase_1/subagent_literature_synthesis.md` containing at least 5 prioritized research gaps, each linked to one or more entries in `sources.bib`.

items.description: Define a reproducible baseline workflow using existing repository tools
items.acceptance_criteria: Write `results/phase_2/baseline_workflow.md` with command-level steps covering Semantic Scholar (`search`, `graph`, `bibtex`) and ConceptEvolve (`evolve`, `walk`, `probe`, `reframe`), plus explicit input/output contracts for each step.

items.description: Establish baseline metrics schema and quality gates
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/phase_2/metrics_schema.json` with at least 8 metrics including `best_lower_bound`, `error_bar_width`, `certificate_status`, `runtime_seconds`, and `reproducibility_delta`, each with exact threshold definitions.

items.description: Reproduce literature baseline bounds as calibration targets
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/phase_2/baseline_calibration.md` that verifies the known benchmark `B_u > 0.5708858` and the weaker chain-derived lower bound, with citations to `sources.bib` and numeric consistency checks documented to at least 1e-7 where applicable.

items.description: Force concept-tree initialization and branch prioritization
items.acceptance_criteria: Generate and inspect `results/concept_evolve/tree/index.json`, `results/concept_evolve/tree/adjacency.json`, and `results/concept_evolve/tree/walk_paths.json`; produce `results/phase_2/branch_priorities.md` with at least 5 ranked branches and explicit rationale tied to bound-tightening potential.

items.description: Delegate baseline risk and reproducibility audit to subagents
items.acceptance_criteria: Run at least one exploration delegation and one synthesis delegation; write `results/phase_2/subagent_baseline_audit.md` with at least 8 concrete risks, each labeled by severity, detection signal, and mitigation owner.

items.description: Design a Loewner-control extremal program for nontrivial Bu lower-bound gains
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/phase_3/approach_loewner_control.md` defining control variables, admissibility constraints, objective functional for guaranteed schlicht-disk radius, and comparison against at least 3 prior works in `sources.bib`.

items.description: Design coefficient-relaxation optimization with rigorous inequality constraints
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/phase_3/approach_coefficient_relaxation.md` specifying truncation order, inequality set (area/de Branges-type or equivalent), solver plan, and a concrete route from numerical candidate to rigorous certificate.

items.description: Design interval-certified conformal search to avoid false improvements
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/phase_3/approach_interval_certified.md` with parameterization of candidate maps, interval arithmetic validation protocol, and required certificate files for each bound claim.

items.description: Traverse concept-tree paths to produce hybrid method hypotheses
items.acceptance_criteria: Analyze `results/concept_evolve/tree/walk_paths.json` and create `results/phase_3/hybrid_hypotheses.md` with at least 3 cross-branch hybrid methods, each with one falsifiable hypothesis, one measurable signal, and one dependency on a phase-2 artifact.

items.description: Delegate novelty exploration and synthesis for approach portfolio selection
items.acceptance_criteria: Run at least 2 exploration delegations and 1 synthesis delegation; save `results/phase_3/subagent_method_portfolio.md` ranking at least 4 candidate methods by expected bound gain, rigor risk, runtime cost, and implementation complexity.

items.description: Create dependency-aware experiment registry before execution
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/phase_4/experiment_registry.json` with at least 3 method families, explicit dependencies on phase-3 design docs, parameter grids, compute budgets, and expected output artifacts.

items.description: Run systematic ablations across prioritized concept-tree branches
items.acceptance_criteria: Execute at least 30 runs spanning at least 3 branches derived from `results/concept_evolve/tree/`; store per-run metadata under `results/phase_4/runs/` and aggregate outcomes in `results/phase_4/ablation_table.csv`.

items.description: Generate rigorous verification bundles for every candidate improvement
items.acceptance_criteria: For each candidate with lower bound above `0.5708858`, create a bundle in `results/phase_4/certificates/` containing assumptions, interval/error bounds, and independent recomputation logs; reject any claim lacking complete bundle files.

items.description: Compare experimental outcomes directly against prior literature
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/phase_4/literature_comparison.md` with a table comparing best observed bounds to at least 5 references in `sources.bib` (including Skinner 2009), reporting absolute/relative delta and rigor-level differences.

items.description: Delegate independent replication and discrepancy synthesis
items.acceptance_criteria: Perform one exploration delegation for reruns and one synthesis delegation for discrepancy analysis; save `results/phase_4/subagent_replication_review.md` showing reproducibility delta <= 1e-4 on at least 5 representative runs.

items.description: Consolidate final bound claim with auditable evidence trace
items.acceptance_criteria: Write `results/phase_5/final_bound_claim.md` containing theorem-style claim, best certified lower bound, proof assumptions, and explicit links to the corresponding `results/phase_4/certificates/` artifacts.

items.description: Perform robustness, sensitivity, and failure-mode analysis
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/phase_5/robustness_report.md` quantifying sensitivity to major hyperparameters and assumptions, with at least 3 documented failure modes and mitigation status for each.

items.description: Document full research dependency graph across phases and concept modules
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/phase_5/dependency_graph.json` and `results/phase_5/dependency_graph.md` mapping all phase artifacts, explicit prerequisites, and links to concept folders under `results/concept_evolve/tree/`.

items.description: Draft manuscript-grade narrative grounded in prior work
items.acceptance_criteria: Produce `results/phase_5/manuscript_draft.md` covering methods, experiments, limitations, and comparison to literature, with at least 10 in-text citations that correspond to entries in `sources.bib`.

items.description: Delegate final peer-style exploration and synthesis review
items.acceptance_criteria: Run at least one exploration delegation and one synthesis/review delegation; save `results/phase_5/subagent_final_review.md` with a release checklist, all critical issues resolved or explicitly waived with rationale.
